To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we present a UAV-based autonomous system for image acquisition that maximizes the quality of a dense 3D reconstruction by predicting the confidence in the reconstruction result and by planning further image acquisitions that are tailored for the given scene and the multi-view stereo approach.

1) the confidence in a dense multi-view 3D reconstruction can be predicted in real-time using a deep convolutional neural network (CNN) that is trained with synthetic data; 2) the confidence prediction allows to assess and improve the quality of the reconstruction in a fully autonomous system; and 3) the confidence prediction can be used to plan additional views for an optimal 3D reconstruction.
we present a system for autonomous acquisition of high resolution images that maximize the reconstruction quality.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following aspects: (i) autonomous acquisition of close-range high-resolution image data, (ii) quality assurance of the acquired images, and (iii) autonomous planning of further image acquisitions.

the following contributions: (i) a real-time confidence prediction for dense multi-view stereo approaches, (ii) a real-time quality assurance of the acquired data, and (iii) a real-time planning of additional views for a given scene and multi-view stereo algorithm.

the following aspects: 1) autonomous image acquisition with respect to the quality of a subsequent multi-view stereo reconstruction, 2) quality assurance of the image acquisition process, 3) planning of further image acquisitions, 4) real-time execution on-board a UAV.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our approach is capable to autonomously acquire close-range high-resolution imagery that is tailored to a later-on 2.5D reconstruction with respect of coverage and 3D quality.
the presented approach is capable of autonomous image acquisition for multi-view stereo reconstruction.
the proposed approach is a promising step towards autonomous close-range high-resolution imaging with respect to the quality of a 3D reconstruction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are able to acquire a high-resolution 3D model of an outdoor scenario in an autonomous way with high-quality and high-coverage.
we are able to autonomously plan a sequence of UAV flights that maximizes the quality of the later-on reconstruction with respect to ground resolution and 2D and 3D reconstruction quality.
we show a fully autonomous UAV-based image acquisition system that is able to plan and execute a mission with respect to multi-view stereo quality assurance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we provide a framework to autonomously acquire images for a given multi-view stereo approach that maximizes the expected 3D quality.
the prediction of the multi-view stereo quality can be used as a proxy for the 3D reconstruction quality, which enables autonomous acquisition of high quality 3D data.

we show how a UAV-based system can autonomously decide whether a reconstruction is of sufficient quality and, if not, how it can autonomously decide on a new camera pose that maximizes the reconstruction quality.
